title: Brushed Bronze Paper Towel Holder, 15.5-Inch Wall-Mounted Powder Coated Iron Pipe Style, Pipeline, Allied Brass
description: Wall-mounted paper towel holder for kitchen use with an industrial, pipe-style look — available in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional kitchens. Dimensions: 15.5 inches long (15.5-inch, 15.5in) x 3 inches high (3-inch, 3in) x 4 inches projection (4-inch, 4in). Powder coated iron construction with a clean, decorative finish; protected using a highly durable powder coat for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Mounts firmly to the wall with color coordinated screws (#8 x 1 1/4) and includes installation hardware. Use as a paper towel holder, paper towel rack, or wall mount paper towel dispenser to keep a roll off the countertop. Contemporary design with rustic influences; industrial modern style. Limited lifetime warranty. Pipeline collection for matching pipeline and pipe-style accessories — Allied Brass Pipeline.
